summary.text: Sam Azzinaro is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 37 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He currently serves as deputy majority leader.

paragraphs.text: Azzinaro attended the Rhode Island School of Design, and his professional experience includes working as a carpenter.

In the 2021-2022 legislative session Azzinaro chaired the Veterans' Affairs Committee and was also assigned to the Health, Education, and Welfare Committee, the House Rules Committee and the Special Legislation Committee.
